      29                 :             :  * code paths as they are conditional on whether the atomic value has updated at a very specific time which is difficult
      30                 :             :  * to achieve reliably in tests. Therefore, we want to be able to mock these calls in our tests.

      33                 :             :  * approach of calling operations on a virtual base class and choosing the real or mock implementation at runtime as the
